tools.name: toolknit_text_format
tools.description: Apply one explicit local text transformation. Returns text; writes no files.

tools.name: toolknit_json
tools.description: Format or compact UTF-8 JSON locally. Invalid inputs return no original text in diagnostics.

tools.name: toolknit_base64
tools.description: Encode or decode UTF-8 Base64 locally. This is encoding, not encryption.

tools.name: toolknit_url_codec
tools.description: Encode or decode a URL component locally; does not visit the URL.

tools.name: toolknit_uuid
tools.description: Generate 1-100 UUID v4 identifiers. They are identifiers, not passwords.

tools.name: toolknit_jwt_decode
tools.description: Decode a caller-supplied JWT header and payload locally. Does not verify the signature, authorize a user or return the signature.

tools.name: toolknit_hash
tools.description: Compute a local file or UTF-8 text checksum. MD5 and SHA-1 are legacy checksums, not authentication. No encryption keys are accepted.

tools.name: toolknit_timestamp
tools.description: Convert an explicit Unix timestamp or ISO date with timezone to UTC. No guessed timezone or clock-dependent output.

tools.name: toolknit_bmi
tools.description: Calculate adult BMI and estimated body composition using the desktop formula. Informational estimates, not a diagnosis. Height/waist/neck/hip in cm, weight in kg.

tools.name: toolknit_mortgage
tools.description: Estimate a repayment schedule. Principal in currency units; annual_rate is percentage; term_years is years. Excludes fees and lender-specific rounding.

tools.name: toolknit_interest
tools.description: Estimate simple, compound or recurring investment interest; rate in percent and term in years. Recurring deposits occur at the beginning of each month. Excludes fees/tax.

tools.name: toolknit_color_convert
tools.description: Convert an explicit sRGB HEX color into RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK, XYZ, Lab/LCH D65 and OKLab/OKLCH using the desktop engine.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_to_word
tools.description: Convert a text-based PDF to editable DOCX with the desktop layout engine. Default offline; ai_mode=true explicitly sends selected text/region images to the environment-configured vision AI for layout classification. Complex regions may remain images; no scanned OCR. Scoped engine license applies.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_text
tools.description: Extract selectable PDF text and reconstruct local Markdown reading order and tables. Does not perform OCR. Returns status and publishes UTF-8 .md or .txt; no network.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_crop
tools.description: Crop selected PDF pages using a normalized rectangle in the rotated visible page: x/y at top-left, width/height in 0..1. Unselected pages remain. Cropping changes page boxes, NOT secure redaction.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_page_number
tools.description: Add page numbers locally. Reuses desktop position/rotation and font layout; source is unchanged. Form fields are flattened when copying pages.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_to_scan
tools.description: Create an image-only PDF with faithful, grayscale or natural scan appearance. This removes searchable text, links, annotations and form behavior. Explicit local operation, no OCR and no network.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_create
tools.description: Create a blank PDF without uploading an existing file. A4 or letter, portrait or landscape; 1-100 pages.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_image_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert ordered local images into a PDF, optionally with grayscale/natural scan appearance. PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/GIF and multi-page TIFF supported. Animated images require explicit frame_policy=first. Uses desktop page-size, DPI and scan algorithms; no OCR.

items.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_image_convert
tools.description: Convert 1-100 local raster images to PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, static GIF or SVG with an embedded PNG (not vector tracing). Preserves displayed dimensions/orientation; JPEG/BMP use white for transparency. Animated/multi-page sources require frame_policy=first. Unique outputs.

items.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_dir.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_image_compress
tools.description: Optimize PNG/JPEG/WebP images locally, preserving dimensions. PNG/WebP are lossless; JPEG quality high/medium/low uses 90/75/60. Only smaller results are published; no-reduction creates no file. Animated sources are rejected.

items.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_dir.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_image_crop
tools.description: Crop a static local image with integer pixel coordinates after EXIF orientation, optional quarter-turn and flips. Rectangle must lie inside the transformed image; source is preserved.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_image_color_replace
tools.description: Replace an explicit source color with a target using the desktop Lab-distance/edge-softness engine. Optional connected-region selection requires a pixel seed. Output is PNG and keeps alpha.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_image_icons
tools.description: Create a ZIP with aspect-preserving transparent PNG icons, ICO/favicon and an embedded SVG wrapper from one static image. Reuses desktop ICO/SVG generation; no external assets.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_polish
tools.description: Polish up to 12000 characters using an explicitly chosen style. Sends only the supplied text/style to the AI provider configured in process environment. Returns text without writing files; never reads desktop credentials.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_translate
tools.description: Translate up to 12000 characters with the environment-configured AI provider. Validates aligned originals against caller input; returns translated text and pairs. Sends the supplied text to the configured endpoint.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_ai_markdown
tools.description: Use the configured vision AI to transcribe up to 20 selected PDF pages and build a Markdown reading guide. Sends rendered page images and extracted model fragments to that provider. This is an explicit network operation; use pdf text for offline extraction.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_excel_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert an explicit .xlsx workbook to PDF with an installed LibreOffice runtime in an isolated temporary profile. Preserves workbook print layout; rejects macros, embedded objects and external data connections. WPS/Microsoft Office are not substitutes.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_markdown_html
tools.description: Export local UTF-8 Markdown as standalone HTML with tables, task lists and MathML formulas. Raw HTML is escaped, images are represented by their alt text, Mermaid remains code; no browser or network is used.

input_path.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

output_path.description: Explicit destination. Sources are preserved; existing outputs require overwrite=true.

tools.name: toolknit_files_large
tools.description: Read-only bounded scan of one explicit directory for large files. Never deletes, follows links or scans implicit system locations. Reports truncated/skipped counts; sizes are bytes.

directory.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

tools.name: toolknit_files_duplicates
tools.description: Read-only scan for byte-identical file duplicates using size then SHA-256. Does not delete anything. Skips symlinks, caps per-file hashing at 256 MiB and total hashing at 2 GiB, and reports incomplete scans.

directory.description: Explicit regular local file; no symlinks or junctions.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a local PDF without writing files. Returns its absolute path, byte size, and page count.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge two or more local PDFs. Output is created only at output_path. page_selections is optional; omitted inputs contribute every page in source order.

items.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_split
tools.description: Export selected pages from one local PDF as individual PDFs in output_dir. The input PDF is never modified.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_rotate
tools.description: Create a rotated PDF. Use rotation to rotate every page, or page_rotations for explicit per-page rotations. Rotation is a multiple of 90 degrees.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_encrypt
tools.description: Create an encrypted PDF using a password of at least 8 characters. The password is handled in memory and is never included in result data or logs.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

password.description: Secret. Do not place it in output paths or logs.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_decrypt
tools.description: Create an unprotected copy of a local PDF. The optional password is handled only in memory and is never included in result data or logs.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

password.description: Optional secret. Omit when no open password is set.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_compress
tools.description: Compress a PDF locally. structure preserves document objects; raster explicitly creates an image-only PDF and loses searchable text, links, forms and bookmarks. target_bytes is a strict upper limit. Already compliant, no-reduction and target-not-reached results create no output.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

clarity.description: Raster resolution floor: readable 72 DPI, compact 36 DPI. Compact can blur small text; neither option guarantees readability.

target_bytes.description: Optional final PDF byte cap. A missed cap never publishes an oversized file.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_enhance
tools.description: Render and enhance a scanned or image-based PDF locally. Output pages are rasterized; searchable text, links, and forms are not preserved.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_pdf_to_image
tools.description: Export one explicit local PDF as page images or as stitched long images. In images mode each selected page is exported separately; in long mode selected pages are stitched into one or more long images. Processing is local, the source PDF is never modified, and outputs are published with unique names only after successful rendering. Resolve paths from the IDE file tree; do not infer them from the MCP process directory.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a PDF file.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for exported PDF images. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates unique names.

pages.description: Optional page numbers already expanded by the caller. Omit to export all pages in images mode or all pages up to the long-image limit in long mode.

mode.description: Individual pages, vertical/horizontal strips, or a grid of exactly 4 or 9 pages. Pages follow PDF page order.

output_name.description: Optional file name stem without a path or extension. ToolKnit still adds a numeric suffix rather than overwriting an existing file.

tools.name: toolknit_audio_convert
tools.description: Convert one to 100 local audio files with FFmpeg. Supports MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC, ALAC, and OGG targets. AAC and ALAC produce .m4a. Output files are created only in output_dir, use unique names, and are published only after a successful encode.

items.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a local audio file. Supported inputs: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, FLAC, ALAC, OGG, and WMA.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for converted audio. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates a unique name.

quality.description: Encoding quality for MP3, AAC, FLAC, and OGG. WAV and ALAC use fixed lossless encoders.

tools.name: toolknit_audio_bpm
tools.description: Analyze BPM locally from one supported audio file. It uses only the first 120 seconds, never uploads, changes, or creates audio files, and returns the primary BPM, confidence, and up to five candidates. Resolve the input path from the IDE file tree; do not infer it from the MCP working directory.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, or M4A file. Must be a regular file no larger than 50 MB and no longer than 5 minutes.

tools.name: toolknit_audio_clip
tools.description: Trim one local audio file between explicit start_seconds and end_seconds. The source is never changed. By default ToolKnit preserves its source container with stream copying when possible, otherwise it publishes a clearly reported MP3 fallback. Resolve paths from the IDE file tree; never infer times or paths from chat context.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a local audio file. Supported inputs: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, FLAC, ALAC, OGG, and WMA.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for converted audio. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates a unique name.

end_seconds.description: First excluded timestamp in seconds; it must be at least 0.1 seconds after start_seconds and no later than source duration.

target_format.description: Optional. Omit to preserve the source container when stream copying is safe; mp3 explicitly re-encodes as MP3.

tools.name: toolknit_audio_extract
tools.description: Extract a selected local video audio track into an explicit output directory without modifying the source.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for converted audio. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates a unique name.

tools.name: toolknit_model_list
tools.description: List the local offline transcription models shared by ToolKnit desktop and CLI. This does not download or modify files.

tools.name: toolknit_model_install
tools.description: Download and integrity-verify one offline Whisper model. The model is installed locally and shared with ToolKnit desktop. Use small unless the user explicitly needs faster base or higher-quality medium.

tools.name: toolknit_model_use
tools.description: Choose an already installed offline transcription model as the current ToolKnit model.

tools.name: toolknit_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe one explicit local audio or video file with the installed offline model. The source is never uploaded or changed. It creates original JSON, SRT, and TXT in output_dir with unique names. refine=true additionally sends recognized subtitle text, never the media, to the configured AI provider; timecodes and IDs are preserved. First call toolknit_model_list and, only if needed, ask the user before downloading a model.

input_path.description: Absolute path to one explicit MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WebM, or similar supported local media file.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for JSON, SRT, and TXT outputs. In an IDE, use an absolute directory inside the workspace.

refine.description: Optional. Send only recognized subtitle text to the configured AI provider for constrained punctuation and grammar refinement; every segment ID and timecode is preserved.

tools.name: toolknit_video_convert
tools.description: Convert one to 30 explicit local video files with local FFmpeg processing. Supported inputs are MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WebM, FLV, WMV, TS, and M4V; targets are MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WebM, FLV, WMV, or TS. The source is never modified. Outputs are published with unique names only after a non-empty successful encode. Resolve paths from the IDE file tree; do not infer them from the MCP process directory.

items.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a local MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WebM, FLV, WMV, TS, or M4V file.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for converted video. In an IDE, resolve the workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates a unique name.

tools.name: toolknit_video_frame
tools.description: Extract one frame from one explicit local video at timestamp_ms. PNG is lossless; JPG uses high quality. The source is never changed, and the output is published with a unique name only after FFmpeg produces a non-empty image. In an IDE, resolve the requested timestamp explicitly from the user or video preview; never guess it.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a local MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WebM, FLV, WMV, TS, or M4V file.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for converted video. In an IDE, resolve the workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates a unique name.

tools.name: toolknit_video_gif
tools.description: Create one palette-optimized GIF from an explicit start_ms to end_ms segment of one local video. The selection must be 30 seconds or shorter. The source is never changed; the GIF is first verified as non-empty and then published under a unique name. In an IDE, resolve the video path and both frame times from the file tree and user preview. Do not infer a highlight or guess a range; use quality small or tiny when the user asks for a smaller GIF.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to a local MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WebM, FLV, WMV, TS, or M4V file.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for converted video. In an IDE, resolve the workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. Existing files are never replaced; ToolKnit allocates a unique name.

start_ms.description: First included frame timestamp in milliseconds.

end_ms.description: First excluded frame timestamp in milliseconds. It must be after start_ms, within the video, and no more than 30 seconds later.

quality.description: Palette/dither preset. high is clearest; small and tiny reduce file size.

tools.name: toolknit_text_stats
tools.description: Calculate deterministic local statistics for one explicit UTF-8 text file without writing files or returning its text content. Returns Unicode character, word, line, paragraph, sentence, punctuation, and reading-time counts. Rejects symbolic links, invalid UTF-8, binary data, and text above 1,000,000 UTF-16 code units.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one regular UTF-8 text file. Resolve it from the IDE file tree; content is analyzed locally and never returned.

tools.name: toolknit_color_extract
tools.description: Extract a deterministic dominant palette from one explicit local PNG, JPEG, or WebP image without writing files. Returns ordered HEX, RGB, HSL, population, and percentage values; the source image is not uploaded or returned.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one regular PNG, JPEG, or WebP image. Resolve it from the IDE file tree.

tools.name: toolknit_image_stitch
tools.description: Stitch 2 to 100 explicit local images vertically or horizontally. Processing is local, source files are never modified, animated GIF is rejected, and a completed PNG/JPG is published with a unique name in output_dir. Preserve the user or IDE file-tree order exactly unless they explicitly request reordering.

items.description: Absolute path to one JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or static GIF image.

output_dir.description: Explicit output directory. In an IDE, resolve an absolute directory inside the active workspace; never rely on the MCP working directory.

output_name.description: Optional file name stem without a path or extension. ToolKnit still adds a numeric suffix rather than overwriting an existing file.

reference.description: Reference width for vertical mode or reference height for horizontal mode.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_images
tools.description: Extract embedded image assets from one local PPTX without modifying the presentation. It preserves original image bytes, assigns stable item numbers, can filter by slide pages or image item numbers, can skip exact duplicates, and writes a manifest.json plus manifest.md into a unique output folder. Resolve paths from the IDE file tree; do not infer them from chat context.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one local .pptx file. Resolve it from the IDE file tree; first-stage PPT tools do not support legacy .ppt files.

output_dir.description: Explicit output directory. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder for extracted assets and never modifies the PPTX.

pages.description: Optional slide page numbers to include. Omit to scan/export images from all slides plus unreferenced media assets.

images.description: Optional scanned image item numbers to export. Omit to export all matched assets.

skip_duplicates.description: When true, skip exact duplicate images detected by SHA-256.

dry_run.description: When true, return the scan manifest and selected items without writing image files.

output_name.description: Optional child folder name stem. ToolKnit still adds a suffix rather than overwriting an existing folder.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_text
tools.description: Extract titles, body text, and speaker notes from one local PPTX without modifying it. Writes Markdown, TXT, JSON, or all formats into a unique output folder. Optional ai_mode sends only extracted text, never the PPTX file, to the configured AI provider for outline, speaker-notes, meeting-notes, or study-notes organization.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one local .pptx file. Resolve it from the IDE file tree; first-stage PPT tools do not support legacy .ppt files.

output_dir.description: Explicit output directory. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder and never modifies the PPTX.

pages.description: Optional slide page numbers to include. Omit to extract all slides.

format.description: Output format. all creates Markdown, TXT, and JSON.

ai_mode.description: Optional AI organization mode. none is fully local. Other modes require an AI provider key in the MCP/CLI environment.

dry_run.description: When true, return the scan manifest and selected slides without writing files or calling AI.

output_name.description: Optional child folder name stem. ToolKnit still adds a suffix rather than overwriting an existing folder.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_compress
tools.description: Create an optimized copy of one local PPTX without modifying the source. It repacks the PPTX, removes safe redundant package data, removes unused media, deduplicates exact duplicate media, and can recompress large images for medium/high levels. It writes a manifest.json into a unique output folder and keeps original images when recompression does not reduce size.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one local .pptx file. Resolve it from the IDE file tree; first-stage PPT tools do not support legacy .ppt files.

output_dir.description: Explicit output directory. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder and never modifies the source PPTX.

level.description: low is lossless cleanup and preserves image quality; medium is recommended cleanup plus moderate large-image recompression; high is stronger compression and prioritizes smaller file size.

dry_run.description: When true, return the compression plan and estimated result without writing files.

output_name.description: Optional child folder and file name stem. ToolKnit still adds a suffix rather than overwriting an existing folder.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_to_pdf
tools.description: Render one local PPTX to PDF with LibreOffice headless. ToolKnit pre-validates the PPTX package, writes a PDF plus manifest.json into a unique output folder, never modifies the source PPTX, and reports dependency_missing when LibreOffice/soffice is unavailable.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one local .pptx file. Resolve it from the IDE file tree; first-stage PPT tools do not support legacy .ppt files.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for rendered PPT outputs. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder and never modifies the source PPTX.

dry_run.description: When true, validate the PPTX and dependency status without writing files.

output_name.description: Optional child folder and PDF file name stem. ToolKnit still adds a suffix rather than overwriting an existing folder.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_to_image
tools.description: Render selected PPTX slides to per-page images. It uses LibreOffice headless to create a temporary PDF, then ToolKnit renders selected pages to PNG/JPG/WebP; the temporary PDF is removed and the source PPTX is never modified.

input_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to one local .pptx file. Resolve it from the IDE file tree; first-stage PPT tools do not support legacy .ppt files.

output_dir.description: Explicit directory for rendered PPT outputs. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and use an absolute path inside <workspace>/toolknit-output. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder and never modifies the source PPTX.

pages.description: Optional slide page numbers already expanded by the caller. Omit to export all slides.

dry_run.description: When true, validate the PPTX, page selection, and dependency status without writing files.

output_name.description: Optional child folder and image file name stem. ToolKnit still adds numeric suffixes rather than overwriting existing files.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_outline
tools.description: Generate a structured presentation outline from a text brief. It writes outline.md, outline.json, and manifest.json into a unique output folder. This tool does not read or upload a PPTX and does not generate a PPTX file; it sends only the supplied brief text to the configured AI provider. The outline includes deck type presets, fact boundaries, slide roles, layout intent, and a self-check score for the later PPTX draft workflow.

prompt.description: Complete deck brief, notes, facts, or source text. Never include API keys or secrets.

output_dir.description: Explicit output directory. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder and never overwrites existing outputs.

slide_count.description: Exact number of outline slides to generate.

deck_type.description: Optional deck preset that changes the narrative shape and slide planning strategy.

audience.description: Optional target audience, such as investors, students, users, or internal reviewers.

purpose.description: Optional presentation goal, such as persuade, teach, report, sell, or align a team.

dry_run.description: When true, validate the request and return the generation plan without calling AI or writing files.

output_name.description: Optional child folder name stem. ToolKnit still adds a suffix rather than overwriting an existing folder.

tools.name: toolknit_ppt_draft
tools.description: Generate an editable PPTX draft from a text brief or an existing ToolKnit outline JSON. Prompt mode sends only the supplied brief to the configured AI provider, then ToolKnit writes the PPTX locally. Outline mode does not call AI. It outputs a PPTX, outline.json, outline.md, and manifest.json into a unique folder. Deck type presets from the outline flow are accepted here too.

prompt.description: Complete deck brief, notes, facts, or source text. Never include API keys or secrets. Mutually exclusive with outline and outline_path.

outline.description: Existing ToolKnit outline JSON object returned by toolknit_ppt_outline. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

outline_path.description: Absolute or current-directory-relative path to an outline.json file returned by ToolKnit. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

output_dir.description: Explicit output directory. ToolKnit creates a unique child folder and never overwrites existing outputs.

slide_count.description: Exact number of slides to generate in prompt mode. In outline mode this defaults to the outline slide count.

deck_type.description: Optional deck preset passed through to the outline stage.

audience.description: Optional target audience, such as investors, students, users, or internal reviewers.

purpose.description: Optional presentation goal, such as persuade, teach, report, sell, or align a team.

theme.description: Local PPTX visual theme. Only minimal-mono (black-and-white) is currently rendered; legacy theme values are accepted for compatibility and normalized to minimal-mono.

dry_run.description: When true, validate the request and return the generation plan without calling AI or writing files.

output_name.description: Optional child folder and PPTX file name stem. ToolKnit still adds a suffix rather than overwriting an existing folder.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_overview
tools.description: Inspect local system and core hardware information on Windows without writing files. Returns a read-only overview of the device, OS, CPU, memory, GPU, storage, firmware, and battery state.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_cpu_memory
tools.description: Inspect local CPU and memory information on Windows without writing files. Returns processor specs, memory topology, per-module details, and current usage.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_cpu_memory_live_stats
tools.description: Inspect the current CPU and memory live statistics on Windows without writing files. Returns usage and available memory counters only.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_gpu_display
tools.description: Inspect local GPU and display information on Windows without writing files. Returns graphics adapters, drivers, VRAM, and connected displays.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_mainboard_firmware
tools.description: Inspect local mainboard and firmware information on Windows without writing files. Returns motherboard, BIOS/UEFI, security, chassis, and PCI device information.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_storage_health
tools.description: Inspect local storage and health information on Windows without writing files. Returns physical disks, volumes, capacity, and reliability counters when available.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_network_devices
tools.description: Inspect local network and connected device information on Windows without writing files. Returns adapters, Bluetooth, audio, USB, and camera devices.

tools.name: toolknit_hardware_power_sensors
tools.description: Inspect local power and sensor information on Windows without writing files. Returns the active power plan, battery state, thermal zones, and fans when exposed.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_document
tools.description: Generate a polished A4 document project from a natural-language brief. Returns the PDF, editable .toolknit.json project, clean previews, a high-resolution numbered map for every page, an overview, and revision history. For IDE requests such as "save in this project", resolve the workspace root and pass an absolute output_path inside it.

prompt.description: Complete document brief. Never include API keys or other secrets.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new PDF. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

page_count.description: Exact number of pages required in the rendered PDF.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_document_inspect
tools.description: Inspect an editable ToolKnit AI document without changing files. Returns every stable control number, type, text, style, position, lock state, artifact path, and diagnostic.

project_path.description: Path to a ToolKnit editable document project.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_document_edit
tools.description: Atomically edit a ToolKnit AI document by stable control number. Resolve a natural-language target by inspecting exact control text/type first; ask the user when multiple controls match. Supports single-control text/style changes, document-wide typography/color/alignment rules, position swaps, move/resize, image or content insertion, deletion, locking, grouping, relative alignment, overlap resolution, and undo. Use update_document_style only for explicit global requests; it skips images, dividers, headers, footers, and locked controls unless types is supplied. Image insertion requires an absolute local PNG/JPEG source_path. A successful non-dry-run edit creates a new revision and refreshes all artifacts.

project_path.description: Path to a ToolKnit editable document project.

anyOf.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

source_path.description: Absolute path to a regular PNG or JPEG file, required when type is image. Relative paths and base64 data are rejected.

items.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

first.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

second.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

before.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

after.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

anchor.description: Stable control number such as P1-01, or its internal stable id.

dry_run.description: Validate and render the proposed edit without writing any file.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_document_render
tools.description: Deterministically regenerate the bound PDF, clean previews, and numbered control maps from an existing ToolKnit AI document project without creating a new revision.

project_path.description: Path to a ToolKnit editable document project.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_table
tools.description: Generate an editable ToolKnit AI table project from a natural-language brief. Returns the export file, editable .toolknit-table.json project, preview, and revision history. For IDE requests such as "save in this project", resolve the workspace root and pass an absolute output_path inside it.

prompt.description: Complete table brief. Never include API keys or other secrets.

output_path.description: Explicit destination path for a new CSV, XLSX, PDF, or PNG export. In an IDE, resolve the active workspace root and pass an absolute path inside that workspace; do not rely on the MCP process working directory. Existing files are refused unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file only when explicitly true.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_table_inspect
tools.description: Inspect an editable ToolKnit AI table project without changing files. Returns stable row, column, and chart numbers plus the export and preview artifact paths.

project_path.description: Path to a ToolKnit editable table project.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_table_edit
tools.description: Atomically edit a ToolKnit AI table by stable row, column, or chart reference. Supports cell updates, row and column inserts or deletes, swaps, reordering, sorting, chart updates, and undo. A successful non-dry-run edit creates a new revision and refreshes all artifacts.

project_path.description: Path to a ToolKnit editable table project.

labelColumnId.description: Stable column number, column key, column label, or internal id for chart labels, such as C01.

valueColumnIds.description: Stable numeric column numbers, keys, labels, or internal ids for chart values, such as C02.

values.description: Row values match at most 20 columns; inserted-column values match at most 200 rows.

dry_run.description: Validate and render the proposed edit without writing any file.

tools.name: toolknit_ai_table_render
tools.description: Deterministically regenerate the export file and preview from an existing ToolKnit AI table project without creating a new revision.

project_path.description: Path to a ToolKnit editable table project.

desktopCoverage.note: Interactive selection, annotations and pinned windows require a visible desktop session.
Background monitoring and encrypted personal history stay behind the desktop user controls.
XLSX only; uses LibreOffice and workbook print layout. Legacy XLS, desktop parameter UI and external workbook connections are excluded.
Original/A4 output and explicit AI layout assistance; no scanned OCR. Complex regions may remain images.
Blank pages and explicit page operations; freeform visual object editing is desktop-only. Crop is not redaction.
Real-time scrolling, microphone-following and overlay positioning are interactive presentation functions.
Explicit bounded directory scanning only; no deletion.
Read-only size/SHA-256 duplicate detection; no deletion or arbitrary keep/delete decisions.
System cleanup retains desktop risk review and per-item confirmation; no destructive headless entry.
Current model/DirectML/CPU lifecycle belongs to the Rust desktop runtime. This standalone npm package does not launch the desktop or ship a second unverified inference/download stack.
Standalone safe HTML and MathML; Mermaid remains code and images are not embedded. Interactive editor/drafts are excluded.
Checksums only. Encryption/decryption keys and private plaintext are not placed into Agent transcripts through a new crypto API.
Generated passwords must not enter shell history or Agent/MCP transcripts.
Timing and keystroke practice depend on interactive UI.
